observations: current fallback model dispatches twice when navigation aborts after the custom-protocol dispatch
negotiating transport before command dispatch preserves one Rust dispatch in the normal path
a CSP-blocked custom protocol can select postMessage before the modeled command dispatch
a navigation abort after dispatch rejects the modeled invoke without a second transport dispatch
a later transport failure rejects instead of risking duplicate side effects
limits: This is a dependency-free state-machine model, not WebView2 or WKWebView execution.
It assumes a side-effect-free custom-protocol probe predicts whether the side-effecting POST can use the same transport.
Browser CSP, CORS, preflight, custom-scheme, navigation, and channel behavior still require target-platform execution.
